brief: Greek Revival double house of about 1832: two storeys of brick behind a full-height portico of four columns under a pediment, two front doors, and a rear wing; the two halves share a centre wall. Record: 2 photos plus 7 measured drawing sheets.

facade.notes: the Grisamore House (Jeffersonville IN, 1832), a double house: three storeys of brick with a pediment with a lunette, a two-storey portico of tall columns with iron balconies in the middle, two entries up high stone steps over a raised basement, an iron rail; tall brick buildings built against it; a 1930s car at the curb

why.note: a double house: two families (two brothers) under one front
